1: // Simple Radar Pulse game implementation
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Adjust canvas to full window size
10:   const resize = () => {
11:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
12:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
13:   };
14:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15:   resize();
16: 
17:   // Obstacle definition
18:   class Obstacle {
19:     constructor(x, y, size = 30) {
20:       this.x = x;
21:       this.y = y;
22:       this.size = size;
23:     }
24:     draw() {
25:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff5555';
26:       ctx.fillRect(this.x - this.size / 2, this.y - this.size / 2, this.size, this.size);
27:     }
28:   }
29: 
30:   // Generate random obstacles
31:   const obstacles = [];
32:   const OBSTACLE_COUNT = 50;
33:   for (let i = 0; i < OBSTACLE_COUNT; i++) {
34:     const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
35:     const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
36:     obstacles.push(new Obstacle(x, y));
37:   }
38: 
39:   // Pulse state
40:   let pulse = null; // {x, y, radius, maxRadius, alpha}
41: 
42:   const startPulse = (x, y) => {
43:     pulse = {
44:       x,
45:       y,
46:       radius: 0,
47:       maxRadius: 150,
48:       alpha: 1,
49:     };
50:   };
51: 
52:   // Click or tap triggers pulse
53:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
54:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
55:     const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
56:     const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
57:     startPulse(x, y);
58:   });
59: 
60:   const update = (delta) => {
61:     if (pulse) {
62:       const speed = 300; // pixels per second
63:       pulse.radius += speed * delta;
64:       pulse.alpha = 1 - pulse.radius / pulse.maxRadius;
65:       if (pulse.radius >= pulse.maxRadius) {
66:         pulse = null;
67:       }
68:     }
69:   };
70: 
71:   const draw = () => {
72:     // Dark background
73:     ctx.fillStyle = '#111';
74:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
75: 
76:     // Draw visible obstacles
77:     obstacles.forEach((obs) => {
78:       if (pulse) {
79:         const dx = obs.x - pulse.x;
80:         const dy = obs.y - pulse.y;
81:         const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
82:         if (dist <= pulse.radius) {
83:           obs.draw();
84:         }
85:       }
86:     });
87: 
88:     // Draw pulse circle
89:     if (pulse) {
90:       ctx.beginPath();
91:       ctx.arc(pulse.x, pulse.y, pulse.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
92:       ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(0,255,255,${pulse.alpha})`;
93:       ctx.lineWidth = 2;
94:       ctx.stroke();
95:     }
96:   };
97: 
98:   let lastTime = performance.now();
99:   const loop = (time) => {
100:     const delta = (time - lastTime) / 1000;
101:     lastTime = time;
102:     update(delta);
103:     draw();
104:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
105:   };
106:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
107: })();

(End of file - total 107 lines)
</content>
